article_content: In a commendable effort to control tuberculosis, India has demonstrated remarkable progress. With collaboration from the World Health Organisation, the nation reported a 19% rise in tuberculosis cases, nevertheless achieving an unparalleled 80% treatment success rate. India, which stands as the sole country to conduct a national tuberculosis prevalence survey, is determined to continue this path despite the sharp rise in cases during the pre-pandemic and pandemic era.
